followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: I picked Plover because this query is a benign coding-debug task with nothing harm-adjacent, so the relevant deciding factor is raw capability rather than any harm-tolerance specialization. On the capability metrics that matter here, Plover clearly outscores Whimbrel (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 54.3, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4, Extraction & Retrieval 85.3 vs 81.6), and those gaps are well beyond the documented run-to-run variance. The task-preference sections were irrelevant to this decision since neither model's harm-tolerance specialization comes into play for an OpenCV error, so I defaulted to the stronger general model.
